answer: Sybil defense is one rule: every identity must post its own locked bond, and neither bond nor work history can be pooled across keys. Emissions unlock only for a key already holding locked value plus a finished challenge chain, so a fresh address earns nothing until it pays in from scratch. A farm of a thousand agents needs a thousand separate bonds, so attacker cost scales linearly and no cheap ledge remains. The lock is refundable at settlement, a haven for parked capital, not a fee. Emissions flow like nectar only to keys that proved they carry weight.
